n2b589267e8.why: Kazakhstan is a major oil and gas and coal producer, so its shift toward renewables affects long-term energy demand and power investment in Central Asia.

nc7e4e40f6c.summary: Shipments of humanoid robots have exceeded 40,000 units, but high full-unit prices and long industrial commissioning cycles keep costs high, according to an industry commentator.
nc7e4e40f6c.why: Humanoid robots are an emerging automation technology, and their adoption depends on falling component costs and proven industrial returns.

n3e44819e3b.summary: New per-square-metre normal construction cost amounts will be used to calculate building tax values for 2027 under Real Estate Tax Law No. 1319. The new period begins with these rates.

n77d3ae1d00.summary: Tel Aviv University data show about 270,000 Israelis emigrated in 2023-2025. Experts warn the record wave, led by doctors and engineers, could become a permanent brain drain.
n77d3ae1d00.why: Emigration of skilled professionals reduces an economy's human capital and tax base, which can weigh on long-term growth and productivity.
